text:
alex: deploying a small canary for model redwood-v2-lite to 15% traffic now. plan includes fallback ordering change + short TTL for prefix cache. will post config.
priya: can you paste the fallback ordering + TTL? want to validate enterprise pins aren't evicted.
alex: sure. config snippet below assumed for canary:
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-v2-lite",
  "traffic_percent": 15,
  "fallback_order": ["redwood-v1-stable","redwood-v1-quant"],
  "fallback_ttl_seconds": 300,
  "pin_exceptions": ["cust-42-enterprise","cust-99-compliance"]
}
```
ethan: 300s seems OK for canary, reduces KV cache staleness. but if we drop TTL we might increase tail latency due to misses. monitor heatmaps.
maya: agree on 300s for canary, but let's have a rollback trigger: +5% error-rate or +40ms p90 latency vs baseline for longer than 5m.
samira: add an explicit pin policy for enterprise customers — they should never fallback off their pinned variant. alex add note to rollout doc.
alex: added pin list in the rollout doc and updated canary settings. also point: the change reorders fallback priority so catalog will prefer v1-stable over v1-quant when redwood-v2-lite misses. this is intended to reduce hallucination regressions.
priya: do we need a separate change window for dedicated clusters? some dedicated pools are still on older runtime that doesn't support new fallback ordering semantics.
alex: good catch. dedicated pools in us-west: tag 'legacy-fallback-runtime'. i'll exclude them from the canary. only hosts with runtime >= 3.2 will get the new ordering.
deploy-bot: @alex started rollout of redwood-v2-lite -> 15% (canary). change-id: ch_2026_1891234567. excluded tags: [legacy-fallback-runtime].
ethan: monitoring hooks to enable: latency p50/p90, error-rate, token-throughput, and model-delta score on golden prompts. i'll wire the eval-runner to produce a drift metric every 3m.
maya: confirm rollback cadence: if any trigger fires, we auto-shift traffic back to previous pin list within 2m, then open a postmortem if automated rollback happened.
alex: yes — automated rollback policy active. manual review for postmortem. thresholds: error +5% or p90 +40ms sustained 5m, or model-delta drop >3 points on the golden set.
samira: remember to update customers with pinned variants: I'll message cust success for the two enterprise customers in the pin_exceptions array.
infra-bot: Scheduling note: global change window for this canary is 2026-03-20T22:00Z - 2026-03-21T02:00Z. infra ops oncall: @ethan. if rollback happens outside window, deploy-bot will still execute but flag T-change.
priya: one final ask — can we set fallback_ttl_seconds=600 for customers with high throughput (cust-7, cust-42) to reduce cold-start token cost? maybe via per-customer override.
alex: per-customer TTL overrides supported. i'll add cust-7 and cust-42 to the override table with 600s.
deploy-bot: ch_2026_1891234567: rollout 15% -> in progress. will post heartbeat updates every minute for first 10m. :rocket:
ethan: watching metrics now. tagging baseline dashboards. :eyes:
alex: thanks all — I'll wait for the 10m health check then decide on stepping to 50% or rollback. :thumbsup:
